item.title: Does Text Data Engineering Matter Most? A Single-Turn Capability Evaluation of an NL2SQL Agent
item.author: xifan.zou@outlook.com (Xifan)
item.description: An NL2SQL Agent translates natural-language questions into SQL, and its core design is to ask a clarifying question first when information is missing, mimicking real human interaction, rather than forcing an answer. Over the past year, as the harness idea spread and models kept getting stronger, I began to wonder whether the NL2SQL Agent I built actually has an ask-first advantage. That question is what produced this evaluation. The conclusion, up front: retrieval is the only order-of-magnitude gain. And because retrieval is essentially data processing over text, the Agent’s value in single-turn conversation comes almost entirely from text data engineering.
